mentions.description: A sub-15 KB serverless household budgeting tool designed to be extremely compressible, letting a household edit a budget and share it back and forth between partners via short links or QR codes with no server in the loop.
mentions.problem: Editing and sharing a household budget between partners without a server in the loop.
